# RaidFi

> The Reputation & Social Intelligence Layer for Web3 - making contribution measurable, reputation portable, and social performance analyzable.

RaidFi is building credibility infrastructure for Web3 communities: contribution tracking, reputation scoring, and social analytics for projects and contributors.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of RaidFi's vision, product, and value proposition.
- [Whitepaper](/whitepaper): Full technical and strategic whitepaper.
- [Waitlist](/waitlist): Request early access to RaidFi.
- [Contribute](/contributions): Contributor hub - XP, tasks, referrals.
- [Live Feed](/feed): Live community contributions feed.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the RaidFi team.
